User Story: As a customer, I want to browse products by category so that I can find relevant items easily.
As a customer, I want to search products by keyword so that I can quickly locate an item.
As a customer, I want to filter products by price range so that I can find items within my budget.
As a customer, I want to view product descriptions, prices, and availability so that I can make informed purchasing decisions.
As a customer, I want to add available products to my cart so that I can purchase them during checkout.
As a customer, I want to change product quantities in my cart so that I can adjust my order.
As a customer, I want to pay using a supported payment method so that I can complete my purchase securely.
As a customer, I want to receive an order confirmation so that I can verify my successful purchase.
As a customer, I want to view my order status so that I can track its progress.
As a customer, I want to see the estimated delivery date so that I can plan to receive my order.
As a customer, I want to receive a notification when my order ships so that I know delivery is in progress.
As a customer, I want to view my order's delivery history so that I can review its status changes.
